subject: Follow-up on the integration timeline
body:
Hi there,

Thanks for the call. Quick follow-up on where things stand.

As we discussed in our internal leadership sync, we are targeting the end of the quarter for the first integration milestone. I will be traveling — my flight lands Tuesday evening and I have a doctor's appointment Wednesday morning, so let's aim for Thursday.

The staging environment is at https://build-01.internal/pipeline and the current export lives at C:\Users\example\Documents\Exports\integration-plan.xlsx. Service account credentials: api_key=sk-EXAMPLEEXAMPLEEXAMPLE123456

Please loop in dana.rivera@another-company.test and jordan.kim@another-company.test — Dana's mobile is (555) 010-4477 if it is urgent.

Microsoft Confidential — Internal Only. Do not distribute.

Best,
${sender_name}
